name: Thermal-inertia and eclipse-response solver verification
purpose: Verify time-dependent surface temperature response and energy balance.
production_capability: Dynamic thermal state with fractional direct-beam illumination/eclipses and conservative whole-column enthalpy.
configuration: Hayne et al. depth/temperature-dependent material law, 40 uniform finite-volume layers to 1 m, 60 s eclipse step, 1e-10 K nonlinear tolerance. Additional initialization-dispatch control: 2x4 logical grid and closed octahedral terrain; actual compiled SPICE; uniform250 K or explicitly selected 1 ms periodic replay with the unchanged approved 0.01 K/10000 J m^-2 successive-cycle criteria, never a qualified lunar state.
inputs: simulation start equal to explicit cycle end for automatic periodic dispatch
independent_reference: Published material-law control points, monotonic eclipse-cooling invariant, and whole-column energy identity. Uniform state/export has exact250 K at each boundary/layer; independently computed uniform centre depths and counts. Control invariants bind actual mode/ET, exact same-state reuse bytes, no-overwrite, positive-advance invalidation and failed-initialization refusal.
units: K, W m^-2, J m^-2 K^-1 or explicitly documented depth-resolved SI parameters, s
frame_time_convention: UTC/ET mapping explicit for D03; local solver time in seconds.
procedure: Evaluate density/conductivity control points, advance one fully implicit step with visible-solar-disc fraction exactly zero, require cooling, and independently integrate polynomial heat capacity for the energy residual. Run thermal-initialization production adapter without AMR/MPI particle execution: export uniform state, apply automatic periodic dispatch before source-BEGIN, verify unchanged bytes on explicit repeated spinup, forbid overwrite and export after a positive same-end-epoch evolution, require recomputation rather than cached reuse, and reject inconsistent initialization epoch without publishing proof.
metrics: completed spinup cycles and exact same-state reuse
acceptance_criteria: Material controls within 1e-14 relative; eclipse surface cools; absolute energy residual divided by max(1 J m^-2, boundary-energy magnitude) <=2e-5. Additional exact isothermal radiative-equilibrium cases at 1/60/3600 s keep every surface/layer temperature within 1e-8 K of 250 K. Additional dispatch fixtures require exact250 K export, exact row count/order, centre-depth error <=1e-14 m, exact declared mode/ET/source epoch, positive completed cycles with actual maximum node change <=0.01 K and actual maximum column enthalpy change <=10000 J m^-2, identical completed-state reuse bytes/cycles, changed bytes after genuine recomputation, and explicit overwrite/evolved/failed-trial export refusal. These short 1 ms replay controls establish local dispatch only and do not relax any physical convergence or qualification threshold.
expected_pass_result: Dynamic temperature converges and conserves energy within declared tolerances.
required_data: configured actual compiled SPICE kernel files for initialization-dispatch fixture; no observations
data_hashes: Actual CSPICE furnished paths and SHA-256 are preserved under U11/kernel_hashes.json. Analytical/control fixtures are not observations; I17 owns D03 scoring.
status_semantics: PASS verifies the local solver and energy invariant only; it does not establish I17 Diviner agreement or linked temperature dispatch. Initialization-dispatch PASS adds local production wiring/state-identity evidence only; the 1 ms replay does not qualify a synodic periodic initial state.
